period_phase_detail.basis: author (Wikisource page header: 彭昌) — Wikisource 《樞垣記略》卷二十五·詩文六 lists 「彭昌詩三十三首」 after 潘世恩's; the set includes 「癸丑元旦上詣壽皇殿」 and 「隨駕恭謁慕陵」 — 慕陵 is the 道光 emperor's tomb, so the 癸丑 is 1853 and the poems are 咸豐-era. (Probably 彭蘊章, 軍機大臣 1851–60, with the name garbled; not asserted.) [curated from a cited source]
